segmentation: case-sensitive left-to-right longest match; ties sorted lexically; unmatched ASCII letters each emit one segment; never cross token boundaries

policies.unit: one listed bench sequence, otherwise one unmatched ASCII letter
one listed bench or minim sequence, otherwise one unmatched ASCII letter

measurement: same equal-locus initial-minus-rest contrast as the baseline, using emitted segment counts per original token
conditional_null: same 2,000 token-index draws as the baseline in every source/spacing variant, paired across unit policies
paired_change: grouped-unit contrast minus ASCII contrast; report observed change and the paired conditional difference distribution

source.author: Gabriel Landini
source.title: EVA Alphabet Font Version 2 Reference
source.role: documented connectivity spellings and historical alphabet comparisons; does not settle semantic or manuscript-glyph units

limit: These are analyst-declared segment counts, not manuscript glyph counts, a complete Currier conversion, phonetic units, a language test, or independent validation. All three policies must be reported without choosing a preferred map from the result.
